page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.4xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the AMD EPYC processor delivers strong single-core performance, scoring in the top 25% for both stress-ng single-core CPU tests and Geekbench single-core metrics. Text processing performance is also strong. However, multi-core performance, including stress-ng multi-core and Geekbench multi-core tests, falls within the average range. Memory bandwidth benchmarks, such as read-only small block cached operations at 1232.18 GB/sec and uncached large block writes at 28.02 GB/sec, consistently align with middle-tier performance profiles.

The lack of local NVMe storage means all disk I/O must traverse the network, which may limit performance for storage-heavy workloads despite the high memory capacity. The instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive applications that do not require local disk caching or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers like Redis, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
